verdict.rationale: Apify's SDK documents a SessionPool class that manages proxy IP rotation together with cookies and other session settings, and Apify Proxy is a first-party proxy service. Together these indicate session-bound proxy identity, but no item explicitly says a session identifier pins multiple requests to the same IP. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a session ID parameter that keeps the same proxy IP across requests, details on session lifetime and stickiness guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can route multiple requests through the same proxy IP using a session identifier to maintain a consistent identity

citations.quote: SessionPool is a class that allows you to handle the rotation of proxy IP addresses along with cookies and other custom settings in Apify SDK.
you can rely on Apify Proxy for your scraping needs.
Avoid blocking by smartly rotating datacenter and residential IP addresses.
